rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name + ZIP, retrieved the correct tablet tracking number, attempted an exchange per the user’s preference, then requested and obtained explicit confirmation before initiating the tablet return and the charger cancellation (including reason). However, when the user asked to return the sneakers, the agent executed the return immediately without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation, which violates the policy requirement to confirm before any order-changing write. All actions were on the authenticated user’s orders and tool outputs were used correctly with no fabricated information, but the missing confirmation before the sneakers return fails the pass criteria.
